proof_body:
by
  intro n m hn
  have hp := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp n hn
  set ζ₀ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n) with hζ₀
  have e : ∀ k : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) / (n : ℂ)) = (ζ₀ ^ m) ^ k := by
    intro k
    rw [hζ₀, ← Complex.exp_int_mul, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    ring
  simp only [e]
  split_ifs with h
  · have : ζ₀ ^ m = 1 := (hp.zpow_eq_one_iff_dvd m).mpr h
    simp [this]
  · have hne : ζ₀ ^ m ≠ 1 := fun h1 => h ((hp.zpow_eq_one_iff_dvd m).mp h1)
    have hpow : (ζ₀ ^ m) ^ n = 1 := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hp.pow_eq_one, one_zpow]
    have := mul_neg_geom_sum (ζ₀ ^ m) n
    rw [hpow, sub_self] at this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm)
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : ℤ), n ≠ 0 → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) / (n : ℂ)) = if (n : ℤ) ∣ m then (n : ℂ) else 0
